label: Test intrinsic pure perfection against merely productive fullness and limitation of esse
summary: See docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md#intrinsic-perfection-versus-unrestricted-productive-power-2026-11-24-draft-unreviewed. Distinguish intrinsic real determination from productive virtual possession and substantive higher-mode realization. Reuse #1914 rootUnlimited: nature-based exclusion of an independently classified pure perfection, if it constitutes limitation of esse, contradicts the supplied root under the finite-giver clause. The missing-mode-to-exclusion and exclusion-to-limitation bridges are separate open commitments. The combined bridge can restate fullness by contraposition. Eight local structural variants separate neutral omission, non-contracting essential exclusion and a brute limited root while preserving the same productive witnesses. The preexistence formula survives without intrinsic fullness in the local power-inclusive interpretation of InAct. Registered 64498e7e applies one mode-open IN_ACT_4 predicate uniformly at cause and effect. The tested inventory is restricted to actual witnesses. The historical comparison examines noncognitive life, unity, ontological goodness and active efficacy. The initial challenge of PR #1916 at 35c03763084282b3b33bacf6b4ab274957180cbc reproduced the note's embedded operation and due-scope controls and requested scope repairs. The targeted re-review accepted the repaired checkpoint at 1d63f12806ed9984ea2ea8973295b1e6b1210d59. Attempt 72a86cf4 records the current scoped assessment. Provisional follow-up in draft PR #1970, docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md#source-specific-manifestation-versus-intrinsic-understanding-2026-11-25-provisional: even a source-owned manifestation-specific productive power and objectively correct rule do not alone transfer the subject of a secondary's apprehension. Two local Python structural diagnostics preserve the actual distinct secondary and esse edge, then vary rule provenance and source-side exercise, and compare equations making the recipient content depend on the source mode or a separate rule. Root apprehension and actual cognitive grounding are stipulated, not inferred. No claim of a metaphysical counterexample, Lean certification, new registered route or revised reviewed assessment. Further provisional continuation: docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md#essential-exclusion-and-positive-nature-completeness-2026-11-25-provisional. Distinguish a real nonpure obstruction (inconsistent with strict source purity if applicable), a joint incompatibility of independently classified pure modes, and an exact closure not warranted by productive specificity. A permitted extension of the cited positive nature requirements refutes their entailment of the exclusion, not the essential exclusion itself. Four structural controls and 3,072 finite-family checks passed; pairwise compatibility does not establish joint compatibility.
blocker: A defense of whole-power fullness needs a reason to treat absence of an independently warranted pure OfBeing mode on the same OwnBeing source as a real restriction of its esse. A rival would need to account for the essential exclusion as non-contracting on that same source. Generalization beyond actual witnesses and across the Has/InAct and D/R mappings remains open. For the strongest dispositional rival, independently establish that an intrinsic manifestation-specific nature which excludes actual understanding contracts the source's esse, or warrant the source-scoped real-content preservation premise 191395d0 and its application to independently pure intellectual content. Rule provenance alone does not settle this. Independent semantic challenge and canonical CLI/Lean checks for PR #1970 are pending. Next distinguish the actual articulation required by intrinsically grounded self-apprehension from mere logical subject/object role distinction, and test whether it entails a real constituent or other dependence incompatible with the same source's unity. Even joint compatibility needs an additional positive-exclusion adequacy or real-limitation bridge. No change to earlier reviewed judgment; no formal certification or independent semantic challenge.
